disease_name: Anemia in Chronic Renal Failure (CRF), Anemia in Cancer Patients on Chemotherapy
indication: Treatment of anemia associated with chronic renal failure, Treatment of anemia in cancer patients on chemotherapy to elevate or maintain red blood cell level and decrease the need for transfusions, To prevent reducing of hemoglobin for patients scheduled for major surgery
single_dose: 60 units/kg for 1-2 min 3 times a week, IV or SC for patients with CRF who are not on dialysis || 150 units/kg SC 3 times a week for cancer patients on chemotherapy
mechanism_of_action: stimulates the division and differentiation of committed erythroid progenitors in the bone marrow, frees the same biological and immunological effects as endogenous erythropoietin
activation_conditions: requires specific timing || requires co-administration with other drugs (iron supply)
unsuitable_population: patients in aluminum intoxication or infected, patients with grossly elevated serum epoetin levels >200 mU/mL
